$comment: THE THRESHOLD'S VOICES, AND THEY ARE SORTED BY WHICH SIDE OF THE RAIL THEY STAND ON. North of it: an usher and a steward, both of whom talk about the building as a job. South of it: the gallery -- an old woman, a child, somebody's family, a letter-cutter down from Crownspire -- all of whom talk about the people who are up there now. That split is the map's whole argument said out loud, and no line on either side is impressed with the other. Lines gated on summit_admitted change once the registrar has read the eight; lines gated on summit_climb_begun change once the player has actually gone through the Seal.
